ios.desc:
StrideGate - Walk to Unlock

Move first, scroll later. StrideGate links with Apple Health to count every step and keeps the apps you pick locked until you hit your daily goal so you curb doom-scrolling, cut screen-time, and build a rock-solid walking habit.

Why StrideGate?
	•	Walk-to-Unlock – gate any app behind your step target
	•	Instant HealthKit sync – no extra wearables needed
	•	Smart inactivity nudges – gentle reminders to get moving
	•	Streak & calendar view – weekly / monthly progress at a glance
	•	Custom goals & themes – set targets, colors, calorie estimates
	•	Win moments – confetti celebrations + motivational quotes


  **Note: StrideGate requires an active subscription or lifetime purchase to access all features. Free trial available with Yearly plan.**
Plans
StrideGate Pro Weekly	Auto-renewing each week
StrideGate Pro Monthly	Auto-renewing each month
StrideGate Pro Yearly	Auto-renewing each year( 3 day trial available ) 
StrideGate Pro Lifetime	One-time purchase

Privacy & Terms
	•	Privacy Policy: sites.google.com/view/stridegateprivacypolicy/home
	•	Terms of Service: apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html

StrideGate reads step data from the Apple Health app to power all features. Your health data never leaves your device without your consent.
